Transfer grades, colors & settings to a new version

In your previous MinervaDash file, select Export backup. In the new version, select Restore backup and choose that file. All grades, course colors, and chart preferences transfer together.

Import calendar screenshot or .ics file

Drop a calendar screenshot, choose an image, or paste a screenshot while this area is selected. AI can interpret calendar layouts, subjects, due dates and percentages. Check the extracted assignments before saving.

AI connection AI reads the uploaded image directly, including layout, course names, deadlines, submission statuses, and weights. This standalone file uses your personal Gemini API key; your image is sent to Google only when you press Analyze image with AI. The key stays in this browser tab and is not saved. Performance Tracker

Cumulative GPA by week

Progress

Course

Current stateA reading of the course’s recent cumulative-grade pattern: whether scores have been stable, rising, declining, recovering, or alternating. This is an interpretation of your logged grades, not a prediction.

Grade over time

Grades are cumulative averages. Missing weeks are left unrecorded; the line connects only the grades you entered.

Course score breakdownView the recorded grade components for each academic week. Use Coming up to add or edit assignments. Blank grades are not zero, and the calculations do not change Weekly grades.

Recorded components

Grade summary

Assignments progressAssignments share a compact 0–5 grade scale. Each dot marks its assignment’s score, including fractional scores between the numbered ticks. A dash means not graded, not zero.

Combined aspect contributionsFormula: sum of (score × course weight) ÷ sum of weights of graded components. Ungraded assignments are excluded until their scores are entered. A 0% aspect is shown in grey and has no effect on the calculated grade. The example weights from MC50 are filled for MC only; verify them against your course's actual grading policy.
